selection.summary: Issue #1241 concerns ensuring the first input position is valid for a match even on first usage of a context, by starting the reference at 1 instead of 0. Relevant evidence: zstd_fast.c (h1) and zstd_double_fast.c (h9) contain the hash-table initialization and first-block loading logic where the 0-position reference occurs; zstd_compress_internal.h (h0, h14) provides the shared window/update helpers governing valid match positions.
